player_signals.summary: Sunday Night BAL@ATL FINAL/OT: Ravens 30, Falcons 23 (ESPN summary status Final/OT; X final posts ~03:46-04:10Z). Regulation ended 23-23 after Huntley's 7-yd TD pass to Devontez Walker with 0:40 left and Henry's 2-pt run; Baltimore won it with Huntley's 1-yd TD run in OT (2:57 left) and Kyle Hamilton intercepted Tua Tagovailoa to end it. NEW: Penix suffered a rib injury late. ESPN play-by-play: he was sacked/fumbled at 0:27 of the 4th (~03:21Z) with 'ATL-M.Penix was injured during the play', returned at 0:13 ('Injury Update: ATL-M.Penix has returned to the game'), then left again; Falcons reporter Tori McElhaney posted 'Michael Penix Jr. has a rib injury and is questionable to return. Tua Tagovailoa coming back in' (~03:43Z, during OT) and relayed that, per the Falcons head coach (named in her post as Kevin Stefanski), 'We will know more once we get imaging done' and Penix tried to get comfortable on the sideline but couldn't by the 4th quarter. A non-official X account says he took a shot to the ribs and never took an OT snap (not independently confirmed). ESPN's game injury table now lists Penix Questionable (ribs). Final line per ESPN box score: 19/32, 240 yds, 1 TD (Kyle Pitts, 5 yds), 0 INT, 3 sacks, 2 rush for 8 yds, 1 fumble (0 lost per box). No imaging result, diagnosis, or Week 6 status has been reported as of this read (~04:15Z).
